label: authorised representative
definition: An entity established in the Union appointed by a third-country provider of a general-purpose AI model to perform specific compliance tasks on its behalf.
source_quote: providers established in third countries shall, by written mandate, appoint an authorised representative which is established in the Union

label: verify that the technical documentation specified in Annex XI has been drawn up and all obligations referred to in Article 53 and, where applicable, Article 55 have been fulfilled by the provider
definition: The duty of the authorised representative to check that the required technical documentation exists and that the provider has met their obligations under Articles 53 and 55.
source_quote: verify that the technical documentation specified in Annex XI has been drawn up and all obligations referred to in Article 53 and, where applicable, Article 55 have been fulfilled by the provider

label: keep a copy of the technical documentation specified in Annex XI at the disposal of the AI Office and national competent authorities, for a period of 10 years after the general-purpose AI model has been placed on the market, and the contact details of the provider that appointed the authorised representative
definition: The duty of the authorised representative to maintain copies of technical documentation and provider contact details available to authorities for ten years post-market placement.
source_quote: keep a copy of the technical documentation specified in Annex XI at the disposal of the AI Office and national competent authorities, for a period of 10 years after the general-purpose AI model has been placed on the market, and the contact details of the provider that appointed the authorised representative

label: provide the AI Office, upon a reasoned request, with all the information and documentation, including that referred to in point (b), necessary to demonstrate compliance with the obligations in this Chapter
definition: The duty of the authorised representative to supply requested information and documentation to the AI Office to prove regulatory compliance.
source_quote: provide the AI Office, upon a reasoned request, with all the information and documentation, including that referred to in point (b), necessary to demonstrate compliance with the obligations in this Chapter

label: cooperate with the AI Office and competent authorities, upon a reasoned request, in any action they take in relation to the general-purpose AI model, including when the model is integrated into AI systems placed on the market or put into service in the Union
definition: The duty of the authorised representative to assist authorities in actions related to the model, including when it is integrated into other systems.
source_quote: cooperate with the AI Office and competent authorities, upon a reasoned request, in any action they take in relation to the general-purpose AI model, including when the model is integrated into AI systems placed on the market or put into service in the Union

label: be addressed, in addition to or instead of the provider, by the AI Office or the competent authorities, on all issues related to ensuring compliance with this Regulation
definition: The status granted to the authorised representative allowing them to be contacted directly by authorities regarding compliance issues.
source_quote: The mandate shall empower the authorised representative to be addressed, in addition to or instead of the provider, by the AI Office or the competent authorities, on all issues related to ensuring compliance with this Regulation

label: terminate the mandate if it considers or has reason to consider the provider to be acting contrary to its obligations pursuant to this Regulation. In such a case, it shall also immediately inform the AI Office about the termination of the mandate and the reasons therefor
definition: The duty of the authorised representative to end their representation if the provider violates obligations and to notify the AI Office immediately.
source_quote: The authorised representative shall terminate the mandate if it considers or has reason to consider the provider to be acting contrary to its obligations pursuant to this Regulation. In such a case, it shall also immediately inform the AI Office about the termination of the mandate and the reasons therefor
